{{Short description|Italian mathematician}}
'''Stefano Montaldo''' is an Italian [[mathematician]] and professor working at the [[University of Cagliari]]<ref>[https://web.unica.it/unica/it/ateneo_s07_ss01.page?contentId=SHD30548 Faculty profile], University of Cagliari, retrieved 2024-05-23.</ref> in the fields of [[differential geometry]], [[global analysis]], and [[biharmonic map]]s.

Montaldo earned his Ph.D. from the [[University of Leeds]] in 1996, under the supervision of [[John C. Wood]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=20436}}</ref>
